body:
Addressed:

1. Added before and after Stock page screenshots to the PR body. The captures show the same one-part workflow after Apply.
   Before, Apply refuses the empty source. After, Apply creates stock from `box`.
   Evidence: [before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/a0c37b16c84a536ffc200219c2d487f24fca7e8a/3268/stock-from-model-before.png) and [after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/a0c37b16c84a536ffc200219c2d487f24fca7e8a/3268/stock-from-model-after.png).
   The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.
2. Changed `apply_from_model` to use `ShellUi::blank()`. The tests check the model count and the absence of prior stock.
   Before Apply, they check the rendered Source combo value. The one-part test also checks that the model count is 1.
   Pins: `from_model_apply_takes_the_only_part_shown` and `from_model_apply_takes_the_part_shown_of_several`.
   Mutation checks: the seeded fixture makes both pins RED. Restoring the blank fixture makes both GREEN.
   The original Source logic also makes both pins RED. Restoring the fix makes both GREEN.

Quick gate: GREEN, 10 steps. UI library: 1406 passed, 7 ignored. All mapped integration suites pass.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.
The final gate ran with the cache disabled after a local artifact rebuild.

New head: `75bbe6a4533664c6460f5a4f90f3220ad86c1a7f`.
Please re-review this head.
